nodes.premise: GA: pop 35, elitism 4, random_injection 0.15, eval_noise 0.4, 10 episodes per env, 4000 step timeout. code_fixes.md items 4,5,7,8.

nodes.premise: Fix 2026-09-09: PolicyNet 9 outputs matching decode 0-8, randint 0-9; remove screen wrap so off-track triggers death; clip obs; DEFAULT_TRACK simple_oval.json.

nodes.name: drift_reward_lap_v2
nodes.premise: Reward v2: living -0.1, forward clip 5px, drift cap 25, lap 750<1000 offtrack, no double bonus; lap progress hybrid dist/2000+0.005, min 200 ticks, dot-product direction gate.

nodes.name: drift_train_hygiene_v1
nodes.premise: Train hygiene: no input() prompts, model paths in training dir, --generations/--train_duration/--seed/--model-dir, N_ACTIONS=9 MAX_STEPS=4000 consts, stdout guard for pytest.

nodes.name: drift_smoke_20260909
nodes.premise: Smoke gens=2 envs=1: Gen1 best laps=0.5 steps=1334; Gen2 best laps=1.5 steps=710; avg laps 0.06->0.19. Fixes verified: 9-action, no-wrap death, reward v2. Models in training/*.pth.

nodes.name: drift_viz_track_fix
nodes.premise: visualize_model drew gray+car only; switched to env.render() full scene (track+car+HUD). Verified on DISPLAY=:0.

nodes.name: drift_traj_truth_20260909
nodes.premise: Deterministic eval (noise=0, 5 eps): 0 laps, crash (246,142) at step 111 every ep; policy argmax stuck on action 6 (accel+right) 100%. Noisy training fitness (40%% noise) inflated 1.5 laps. Need clean-eval selection + action-diversity pressure before Phase-2 drift.

nodes.name: drift_clean_select_v1
nodes.premise: Selection on clean eval: top-8 noisy candidates re-evaluated noise=0 x3eps; rank by (laps,steps,unique,entropy,-deaths) via _fit_key; best-saves/early-stop on clean; policy-action histogram (noise excluded) with unique/entropy per agent.

nodes.name: drift_parking_gate
nodes.premise: Brake-parking exploit fixed with dist metric in rank key. Relaunch seed7 x3 gens.

nodes.name: drift_smoke_correction
nodes.premise: Correction: drift_smoke_20260909 clean laps 1.5 were noisy-rollout artifacts. Deterministic re-eval showed 0 laps with wall crash, then brake-parking. Do not cite 1.5 as policy quality.

nodes.name: drift_phase1_verified
nodes.premise: Phase-1 verified deterministic: 5 laps x5 eps, 0 offtrack, actions 6/2/0 mixed, full-track bbox, traj_smoke3.csv. Gates worked: dist killed parking, clean-select killed noise luck.

nodes.name: drift_phase2b_style
